title: Lazarus of Bethany and His Sisters
lead: Lazarus and his sisters Martha and Mary lived in Bethany, just outside Jerusalem, and were close friends of Jesus. Luke tells of the two sisters (Luke 10:38–42); John tells how Jesus raised Lazarus from the dead and how Mary anointed Jesus' feet before his death (John 11–12). Lazarus of Bethany is a different person from the beggar Lazarus of Jesus' parable (Luke 16:19–31).
